entities.name: COVID-19 pandemic in Lesotho

entities.summary: The COVID-19 pandemic in Lesotho is part of the worldwide pandemic of coronavirus disease 2019 caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2. The virus was confirmed to have reached Lesotho on 13 May 2020.
